title: The Sharp Extraction
author: Emrys Quintana
blurb: Lior Eriksen, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
